name: Assists
summary:
Assists is an MR application developed by Hololab Inc. for the purpose of "reducing the time and efficiency of education and training".

Using MR technology, digital information (text, images, videos and 3D models) is superimposed, enabling educational training to be conducted in an intuitive and highly learning-efficient hands-on format.

Furthermore, by digitizing and replaying the movements of experts, three-dimensional learning is possible.
